items.description: WSJ 报道，Anthropic 7 位创始人将在 IPO 中各出售约 2.5 亿美元股票，每人保留约 180 亿美元持仓。据公司文件，每人出售近 3.4M 股，发行价区间预计 70 至 78 美元，上市预计下周进行，估值接近 1.3 万亿美元，募资 800 亿美元以上，部分通过包括 Google 在内的私募配售。
items.titleOriginal: WSJ: Anthropic’s 7 founders will each sell about $250M of stock in its IPO and keep roughly $18B apiece.

items.title: 当美国无法建设数据中心，会对 AI 产生怎样的冲击

items.description: 主题监测的任务是在模型生成时的反应中标出每个代号的标注主题. 以激活为基础的监测器在生成时运行至今已经经过了检测有害内容的培训,并且仅限于两到三个课程.
items.titleOriginal: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
items.descriptionOriginal: arXiv:2611.12935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes.
